member.name: PcmResyncToleranceSeconds
member.para: The drift, measured. "Raumschiff Erde.m4b" (17:00:40, 2026-08-02): 202 short packets out of 2637487, 78565 samples of overlap in total, putting the VAD 0.29 s late by 2:46:40, 1.09 s by 10:51 and 1.76 s by the end. That 1.09 s is what moved chapter 25's mark off the announcement and onto the chapter title behind it.

How much of the corpus carries it. Three more of the ten books in that test set have the same defect (0.99-2.15 s); the other six are within 0.07 s. Screening one file costs nothing: compare nb_frames * 1024 against duration_ts from ffprobe -select_streams a -show_entries stream=nb_frames,duration_ts.

member.name: StartProcess
member.para: What an unpinned read actually does today. Measured 2026-08-18 under console code pages 850, 1252, 437 and 65001: an unpinned read decoded correctly every time, because InvariantGlobalization leaves .NET unable to build a legacy code page and its fallback is UTF-8.
